resources.string: Your local identity stays the same until you reset it.
A public fingerprint of this device’s signing key.
Creates a new identity. Existing pairings become invalid; you will need to pair your devices again.
This creates a new device ID and signing key. Existing pairings become invalid; your other devices will need to pair with this device again.
Secure storage is unavailable. Unlock your device and try again. Your identity has not been replaced.
The saved signing key is missing or unusable. Try again, or reset this device’s identity to create a replacement.
The saved identity could not be read consistently. Try again, or reset it to create a replacement.
The identity could not complete its signing check. Try again, or reset it to create a replacement.

Connect a trusted device to send a notification.
Your paired device submitted the notification. Display and sound depend on its system settings.
Notifications are blocked on your paired device. Allow them there and try again.
This request is no longer current.
Your paired device already has an active alert.
The request failed. Notification delivery is unconfirmed.
No response received. Notification delivery is unconfirmed.
Connection closed. Notification delivery is unconfirmed.
Send a notification to a connected trusted device. Sound follows system settings.
Find Device is unavailable. Connect a device with Find Device support.
Notifications are off. Allow them to receive Find Device alerts.

This phone rings for up to 60 seconds when a connected trusted device looks for it, even in Silent or Vibrate mode. Ringing uses your alarm volume and respects Do Not Disturb. Stop it here or in its notification.
Pair a device in Devices to use Find Device.
Disconnected. Connect this device in Devices to use Find Device.
